name: Maggie
source:
A young woman who works as a postman. Along with delivering mail, her profession also includes maintaining order and upholding the law using her sword. Her pointy ears and her feathery antennae marks her as part of a race called Vanes.

[From [URL=https://unfinishedcircl.itch.io/canvas-colors-in-the-moving-city]the official website[/URL]]
